scope: Additive current Super Dragon data and bounded Core integration; every preceding frozen reference remains intact.
game_version: The ordinary payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The secondary current table was updated 2026-08-26 and identifies client build 18.400.21.

sources.title: Clash of Clans Winter 2021
sources.limitations: Establishes any target, ground-and-air targeting, area splash, housing 40, movement 14, and launch stats only. It does not define current cadence, Roast geometry, impact count or timing.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes
sources.limitations: Shows post-launch values changed, so launch figures cannot silently become current values; it does not publish current Roast geometry.

sources.title: Super Dragon — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: Dated client-file table supplies eleven ordinal rows, range 3 and 1.8-second cadence. It publishes neither the raw level-number mapping, TH requirement of row 11, splash radius, burst allocation nor client timing.

official_deltas.behavior: Flying any-target troop that targets ground and air with area splash; housing 40 and movement speed 14.

attack_speed_seconds.note: Dated table resolves the upstream 0.192 field as unsuitable for a whole attack cycle; aggregate Core cadence is 1.8 seconds.

support.note: Core performs one deterministic aggregate primary-target impact per dated 1.8-second cycle. The primary source confirms area splash, but its radius/burst geometry is unknown, so no unsourced secondary victims are simulated.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued only; ten stale upstream rows and 0.192-second field blocked Core materialization
changed_values.replacement: eleven ordinal current rows, 1.8-second aggregate cadence and one primary-target lower-bound impact
changed_values.justification: The dated client-file table supplies the current aggregate stats/cadence while the primary launch source establishes flight, targeting and area-splash class. Unknown splash geometry remains omitted rather than invented.

known_uncertainties: The ordinal table does not expose the raw Super Dragon level mapping or the TH requirement of its eleventh row; L13 is a documented ordered mapping, not a published TH18 claim.

Roast projectile count, burst allocation, splash radius, victim eligibility, target loss, travel, collision, wall interaction and tick order are not public. Core's aggregate primary impact is a lower bound and must be replaced by a versioned attack contract.
The level-3 sprite is the only locally sourced Super Dragon asset; per-level placement/scaling is unverified.
conclusion: This delta makes Super Dragon broadly usable through the shared deterministic adapters while retaining its documented area-splash and Roast gaps as open fidelity work.
